# Emmbros Autocomp Ltd - Comprehensive Technical & Metallurgy Dossier

> Expanded technical documentation, engineering standards, alloy chemistry specifications, heat treatment protocols, and manufacturing equipment details for Emmbros Autocomp Limited (Baddi, Himachal Pradesh, India).

## 1. Company Profile
- **Legal Name**: Emmbros Autocomp Limited (EAL)
- **Founded**: 1991
- **Headquarters**: Plot No. 63, EPIP Phase-1, Jharmajri, Baddi, District Solan, Himachal Pradesh – 174103, India
- **Core Industry**: Tier-1 OEM Automotive, Tractor, and Heavy Industrial Forgings & Driveline Components
- **Annual Capacity**: 500,000+ axle shafts; 25,000+ metric tonnes of forged alloy components
- **Key OEM Customers**: Tata Motors, Ashok Leyland, Mahindra & Mahindra, Escorts Kubota, and international drivetrain assemblers

## 3. Product Catalog with Metallurgy Specifications

### A. OEM Rear Axle Shafts (Full-Floating & Flanged)
- **URL**: https://emmbros.com/product-application/rear-axle-shaft
- **SKU**: EAL-RAS-001 | **MPN**: EAL-RAS-SERIES
- **Weight Range**: 0.5 kg to 65 kg (Length up to 1,250 mm; Flange diameter up to 240 mm)
- **Steel Grades**:
  - SAE 1541: Carbon 0.36–0.44%, Manganese 1.35–1.65%, Silicon 0.15–0.35%
  - SAE 15B41: Boron-treated for enhanced deep hardenability (Boron 0.0008–0.003%)
  - EN19 / SAE 4140 (42CrMo4): Chromium-Molybdenum alloy for severe torsional fatigue life
  - EN8D / SAE 1045: Medium carbon steel for agricultural utility applications
- **Heat Treatment**: Full-body or selective induction scanning (Frequency: 10 kHz to 30 kHz); Effective case depth: 4.0 mm to 9.5 mm at 50 HRC cutoff; Surface hardness: 54–62 HRC; Core hardness: 28–34 HRC.
- **Splines**: Involute cold-rolled or hobbed to DIN 5480, ANSI B92.1, and JIS D 2001 tolerances.

### B. OEM Front Axle Shafts & Wheel Spindles
- **URL**: https://emmbros.com/product-application/front-axle-shaft
- **SKU**: EAL-FAS-002 | **MPN**: EAL-FAS-SERIES
- **Weight Range**: 1.0 kg to 45 kg
- **Applications**: 4WD tractor driven front axles, commercial truck steering axles, off-road dumpers.
- **Steel Grades**: EN19 (42CrMo4), EN24 (34CrNiMo6), SAE 1045.
- **Quality Checks**: 100% Magnetic Particle Inspection (MPI) on critical fillet transitions and spline runouts.

### C. OEM Driveline Parts, Cardan Shafts & Yokes
- **URL**: https://emmbros.com/product-application/driveline-parts
- **SKU**: EAL-DLP-003 | **MPN**: EAL-DLP-SERIES
- **Weight Range**: 0.5 kg to 35 kg
- **Product Forms**: Companion flanges, slip yokes, weld yokes, end yokes, stub shafts, propeller shaft components.
- **Steel Grades**: SAE 1045, 20MnCr5, SAE 1141 micro-alloyed forging grades.

### D. OEM Gearbox Parts & Transmission Shafts
- **URL**: https://emmbros.com/product-application/gear-box-parts
- **SKU**: EAL-GBP-004 | **MPN**: EAL-GBP-SERIES
- **Weight Range**: 0.8 kg to 30 kg
- **Product Forms**: Transmission input shafts, countershafts, main shafts, planet carriers, bull gears, speed gears.
- **Steel Grades**: 16MnCr5, 20MnCr5, SAE 8620 case-carburizing steels; Case depth: 0.8 mm to 1.6 mm (58–62 HRC).

### E. OEM Hydraulic Lift Shafts & Cylinder Pistons
- **URL**: https://emmbros.com/product-application/hydraulic-parts
- **SKU**: EAL-HYP-005 | **MPN**: EAL-HYP-SERIES
- **Weight Range**: 1.0 kg to 40 kg
- **Product Forms**: Hydraulic rockshafts, lift arms, hydraulic brake pistons, fluid power connectors.
- **Steel Grades**: EN8D, micro-alloyed carbon steel, medium carbon alloy forgings.

### F. OEM Planetary Wheel Drives & Flange Hubs
- **URL**: https://emmbros.com/product-application/planetary-wheel-drive-parts
- **SKU**: EAL-PWD-006 | **MPN**: EAL-PWD-SERIES
- **Weight Range**: 2.0 kg to 65 kg
- **Product Forms**: Planetary carriers, wheel flange hubs, ring gear supports, sun gears.
- **Steel Grades**: EN19 (42CrMo4), EN24, 20MnCr5.

## 4. Quality Management & Laboratory Equipment
- **Accreditations**:
  - IATF 16949:2016 (Automotive Quality Management System)
  - ISO 9001:2015 (Quality Management System)
  - ISO 14001:2015 (Environmental Management System)
  - ISO 45001:2018 (Occupational Health & Safety)
- **Metallurgical Lab Instruments**:
  - Optical Emission Spectrometer (28 chemical channels including C, Mn, Si, Cr, Ni, Mo, B, V, Al)
  - CNC Coordinate Measuring Machine (CMM, accuracy: 1.8 µm + L/300)
  - Micro-Vickers Hardness Tester (HV 0.1 to HV 5.0 for case depth profiling)
  - Rockwell & Brinell Hardness Testers (HRC / HBW)
  - Fluorescent Magnetic Particle Inspection (MPI) benches (ASTM E1444 compliant)
  - Ultrasonic Flaw Detector (ASTM A388 compliant for internal bar soundness)
  - Optical Metallurgical Microscope for micro-structure (martensite rating, ASTM E45 inclusion rating)
